native.local_backend: Existing shared PyRUA SAM3; all valid candidates, not just top one
native.passive_history: Existing public results/states only; on-demand reads, no sensing, action policy or automatic directory

camera_metadata_context.trigger: Python camera_meta request; bypassed when routing is disabled

native.routing: locate/segment text queries; distinct score-competitive mask hypotheses require explicit choice

ambiguity_heuristic.grouping: highest-score-first representative masks; original candidates retained

native.semantic_change: Ambiguous text perception raises before original top-one geometry; no automatic replay
native.selection_guard: Ordinary catchable Python exception, not a global action interlock

pos.adaptation: cell-level explicit belief, independent sentinel, trapping recovery
pos.execution_checks: feedback-driven recovery; no blanket failed-motion gripper gate
pos.reference_method: Inner Monologue: action outcome + task-progress scene feedback + replanning
pos.metadata_corrections: nonblocking,logged; never rewrite code or fabricate physical success

adaptation.pos_model_calls: original payload fields/prompt prefixes plus schema contract and delivered-source handoff; no report rewriting
adaptation.pos_step_and_completion: original step validation and completion audit; obsolete directives archived after motion
adaptation.planner_handoff: revision-stamped belief/gap, public feedback, compact delivered OpenVL source links and semantic limits; full original evidence retained in POS_CONTEXT
adaptation.auxiliary_input_change: openvl_pos_handoff added to belief, repair and Sentinel payloads; original payload fields retained
adaptation.pos_schedule: existing trigger/final reserve; funded retry capacity may be reserved inside original round/total limits
adaptation.visual_evidence_policy: delivered results only; original source time and eligibility retained
adaptation.dependency_links: optional executor declarations; invalidations only, no promotion

v17_ablation.static_rules_injection: executor instruction prompt only; identical suffix across pairs
